The Cognoscenti · production-grade bar

Use this as the quality bar while refining a feature: clear user intent, understandable copy, reversible actions, explicit consent, correct state transitions, and a safe fallback when a signal is missing. “Verified current” labels reflect the live source audit; planned or incomplete items still need proof.

Friction, not restriction. The user keeps the decision. Python remains shadow-only; Vision remains a DOM-failure fallback, not a parallel observer.
